answer: Reputation-Weighted Cold-Start Escrow: each identity must hold a vault of reputation earned through slow, verifiable work before its votes or payments count at full weight. New identities start in an oasis of low-trust status, capped at minimal transaction value until they accumulate history. Fraudulent clusters detected by shared behavior trigger a glacier-paced freeze, locking escrow for months. Cloning ten identities costs ten full escrow deposits plus ten slow warm-up periods; honest agents pay once and scale immediately.
